documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sacheerome Limited presented its investor presentation for H2 FY26 and full year FY26, reporting revenue from operations of ₹15,238.58 Lakhs compared to ₹10,753.59 Lakhs in FY25. EBITDA for FY26 stood at ₹4,066.15 Lakhs with an EBITDA margin of 26.02%, while PAT grew to ₹2,844.11 Lakhs. The company operates a manufacturing facility in New Delhi with an annual production capacity of 7,60,000 Kg and is currently expanding with a new plant in YEIDA, Uttar Pradesh. Management highlighted sustained growth momentum driven by demand across FMCG, personal care, and food & beverage categories.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company remains well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long-term profitable growth.
guidance.quote: With our strengthened balance sheet, healthy cash flows, and scalable operating platform, we remain well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long -term profitable growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the fragrance and flavour industry continues to witness strong demand across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care segments.
demand_outlook.quote: The fragrance and flavour industry continues to witness strong demand supported by growing consumption across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories.

capex_expansion.claim: Sacheerome is investing in a new manufacturing plant in YEIDA, Uttar Pradesh to enhance its production capabilities.
capex_expansion.quote: Sacheerome operates from its advanced manufacturing facility in New Delhi and is investing in a state-of- the-art plant in YEIDA, Uttar Pradesh to further enhance production capabilities .

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company achieved margin expansion alongside robust revenue growth during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Our ability to deliver superior margin expansion alongside robust revenue growth reflects the strength of our business model, product portfolio, and execution capabilities.

capital_allocation.claim: The company highlighted that debt levels remain minimal and liquidity is well-managed.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt levels remain minimal, indicating financial stability, while liquidity is well-managed.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted potential business risks including macroeconomic trends, regulatory changes, currency and interest rate movements, and competitive pressures.
risks_headwinds.quote: These factors include, but are not limited to, general market, macro economic, governmental and regulatory trends, movements in currency exchange and interest rates, competitive pressures, technological developments, changes in the financial conditions of third parties dealing with us, legislative developments, and other key factors that could affect our business and financial performance .
